method: Distance is the step count multiplied by the length of one step, and the reverse divides the distance by that length, rounding to the nearest whole step because a counter can only report whole footfalls. One step is a single footfall; a stride is two steps, so a stride measurement must be halved before it is entered here. Lengths are converted with exact factors: one centimetre is 0.01 metres, one inch is 0.0254 metres and one mile is 1609.344 metres. The tool accepts 1 to 1,000,000 whole steps, a step length of 20 to 150 centimetres (8 to 59 inches) with at most two decimals, and a distance of 0.001 to 1,000 kilometres or miles (1 to 1,000,000 metres) with at most three decimals for kilometres and miles. Text, negative values, exponent notation, more than one decimal separator and out-of-range values are refused with the field named. Results are exact for the length entered and are not a measurement: real step length changes with pace, slope, surface and footwear, and a GPS watch counts distance and steps independently, so its figure will usually differ. The 76 centimetre default is a placeholder rather than a personal measurement. Nothing is stored, uploaded or transmitted.
